action.value: Balanced and Automatic to service-owned HyperBoost, one operator-initiated Windows Sleep and resume boundary, one owned Service restoration, then stable read-only lifecycle verification

validation.applyResult: Applied successfully once through the exact installed validation Service while the cooling pad was physically absent.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed mode 7 and durable service ownership before the low-power boundary.
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully once by the same installed Service to the saved Balanced base with Automatic laptop fans.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The validation build bound exact RZ09-0581 identity, BIOS 4.00 provenance, Balanced and Automatic baseline, admitted full-power adapter, physical pad absence, one matching Service, Tray, and Session Agent, and zero blocked or unconfirmed writes.
The installed Service applied HyperBoost once, confirmed mode 7, finalized durable padless ownership, and created the private marker without cleanup or manual recovery.

The operator invoked Windows Sleep once and resumed after approximately fifteen seconds. The typed verifier confirmed the expected same-Service low-power safety boundary; the retained artifact does not distinguish which serialized Windows notification won.

Read-only FirmwareSmoke verification confirmed stable Balanced and Automatic state, a retired journal, the exact installed generation, and exactly one matching Service recovery attempt and completion.

Private marker, diagnostics, deployment, and verification files remain uncommitted. After both lifecycle scenarios, the exact production Service assembly was restored and a final read-only baseline confirmed Balanced, Automatic, zero blocked or unconfirmed writes, and a retired journal.

limitations: This run validates one installed-Service low-power restoration on exact RZ09-0581 hardware with BIOS 4.00 provenance, Balanced and Automatic, an admitted full-power adapter, and confirmed physical pad absence.

The verifier proves the expected serialized low-power safety boundary and exactly one restoration; it does not claim whether the registered suspend callback or the conservative display-off boundary won.
Unexpected-exit recovery is an independent gate and is recorded in a separate exact-generation annotation.

productionAdmission.reason: Exact-head low-power recovery is validated; production admission additionally requires the independent exact-head unexpected-exit annotation.

notes: FirmwareSmoke verification was read-only and issued no recovery write.
No Razer service was started, stopped, or restored.
Private lifecycle markers, diagnostics, local paths, service instance identifiers, and user identity are not committed.
